primary_quantity: PARTIAL Spearman(tau_eff, HELD-OUT log tick rate | abs_return_pct, parkinson_pct), model trained TICK-BLIND; scored against an untrained-initialisation null (z < -3)
benchmark: distribution of the same statistic over 20 untrained tick-blind models (different seeds)
notes: RE-SPECIFIED 2026-08-10; the original form was NOT A VALID TEST and could not fail. Evidence: log_tick_rate was fed directly into tau_net, so UNTRAINED models already scored partial rho -0.7113 / -0.4192 / -0.6129 across seeds, clearing the pre-declared negative bar with no training at all, and the sign flipped between slices (-0.9681 dry vs +0.9437 full H1). The null was never zero -- it was 'what an MLP handed log_tick_rate returns'. AMENDED DESIGN: MODEL B is trained TICK-BLIND (covariates = log_return_pct, abs_return_pct, parkinson_pct only; no log_ticks, no log_tick_rate), and its warp is warm-started from a PRICE-ONLY information-rate proxy (parkinson/dt), not from tick rate -- a Clark tick warm start would leak the held-out observable back in. tick_volume is then genuinely held out and 'tau_eff tracks it' becomes a real discovery. Sign pre-declared NEGATIVE. Cleared only if the trained statistic sits outside the untrained-seed null at z < -3 in that direction. || SCORED 2026-08-10. Model B (tick-blind), epoch 12/30 selected on inner stop[63:70]. Observed PARTIAL Spearman = +0.021842. Untrained-seed null (N=30, identical architecture + price-only warp warm start, no gradient step): mean +0.007424, sd 0.037668, range [-0.073658, +0.101958]. z = +0.3828, against a pre-declared bar of z < -3 in the NEGATIVE direction. Not merely short of the bar — the wrong SIGN and essentially indistinguishable from an untrained network. DROP. ci_low/ci_high above hold the null's mean +/- 3sd (the pre-declared rejection band), not a CI of the estimate. THE RE-SPECIFICATION WORKED, and that is worth recording: under the ORIGINAL design untrained models scored partial rho -0.42..-0.71 and would have 'cleared' with no training at all. With tau_net made tick-blind the untrained null now sits at +0.0074 +/- 0.0377 — centred on zero, as a valid null must be. The instrument was fixed before it was used, and it then returned a clean negative. Note the RAW Spearman was -0.7590 — large and in the predicted direction — while the partial is +0.02. The raw number is entirely explained by the volatility controls, which is precisely the confound the amendment anticipated; reporting the raw figure as the result would have manufactured a discovery. Model B's warp is degenerate on the same defect as Model A (state_retention_weekend 5.42e-10, rate at the ceiling), so this DROP is a verdict on a model whose learned clock had collapsed; it does not establish that no such clock exists.
